title: FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions — Filter Size Changes
content:
A size change to a FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions subscription requested at least 3 calendar days before the ship date applies to that shipment; requested later, it applies to the next shipment. A size change carries the grade's size-change fee only where that fee is above $0.00. Where the grade takes the size from the equipment record at sign-up, the size on the equipment record is used. A Media Cabinet grade can be shipped only to a home whose system has a media cabinet of the grade's depth.

| Grade | Notice for the change to reach that shipment | Size-change fee | Size taken from the equipment record at sign-up | Cabinet depth required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | 3 days | $0.00 | Yes | Not a Media Cabinet grade |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | 3 days | $0.00 | Yes | Not a Media Cabinet grade |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | 3 days | $0.00 | Yes | Not a Media Cabinet grade |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | 3 days | $0.00 | Yes | 4 inches |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | 3 days | $0.00 | Yes | 4 inches |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | 3 days | $0.00 | Yes | 5 inches |

The 1-inch grades ship filters 1 inch deep.

### Questions the rule answers

**Is there a charge for changing the filter size?** The fee is $0.00 for every grade, and a size change carries a fee only where the fee is above $0.00, so no size-change fee is charged under any grade.

**Which shipment receives the new size?** Counting calendar days back from the ship date on the 5th:

| Change requested on | Days before the 5th | New size goes out in |
|---|---|---|
| The 2nd | 3 | That shipment |
| The 3rd | 2 | The next shipment |

**Where does the size at sign-up come from?** Every grade takes the size from the equipment record at sign-up, so the size registered for the home's equipment is the size used.

**Which homes can receive Media Cabinet MERV 16 filters?** Only a home whose system has a 5-inch media cabinet. Media Cabinet MERV 11 and Media Cabinet MERV 13 filters go only to a home whose system has a 4-inch media cabinet.
